parameters.help_en: The workspace that owns the probe permissions, region, and network context
parameters.help_zh: 探测权限、地域及网络上下文所属的工作空间
parameters.name: workspace_id

fields.help_en: A single HTTP(S) URL that reuses the addresses of the origin server from the creation API. Embedded credentials, multiple addresses, or protected targets are not accepted
fields.help_zh: 单个 HTTP(S) URL，复用创建时的源站地址；不接受内嵌凭据、批量地址或受保护目标
fields.name: address

fields.help_en: The name of the backend authentication header
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The value of the backend authentication header
fields.name: value

fields.help_en: The backend authentication configuration for the direct proxy
fields.help_zh: 直连代理的后端认证配置
fields.name: direct_proxy

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable this configuration
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The credential for the backend authentication
fields.name: credential

fields.help_en: The ID of the backend authentication configuration
fields.name: id

fields.help_en: The name of the API key parameter
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The location where the API key is passed
fields.name: position

fields.help_en: The type of the backend authentication
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The list of backend authentication configurations for HTTP to MCP
fields.help_zh: HTTP 转 MCP 的后端认证配置列表
fields.name: http_to_mcp

fields.help_en: Reuses the enabled, directProxy, and httpToMcp origin server authentication fields and validations from the creation API. If enabled is set to true, you must provide a configuration that matches the access type. codePackage or additional headers are not accepted
fields.help_zh: 复用创建的 enabled、directProxy 和 httpToMcp 源站鉴权字段及校验；enabled=true 时须提供与接入类型匹配的配置，不接受 codePackage 或额外 Header
fields.name: auth

fields.help_en: Used only for HTTP. Reuses the JSON or YAML string semantics from the creation API. This field is required when validating the definition. Remote documents or references are not automatically fetched
fields.help_zh: 仅 HTTP 使用，沿用创建的 JSON/YAML 字符串语义。定义检查时必填，不自动抓取远端文档或引用
fields.name: swagger_config

fields.help_en: The access type. Valid values: DIRECT_PROXY and HTTP_TO_MCP. CODE_PACKAGE is not supported
fields.help_zh: DIRECT_PROXY 或 HTTP_TO_MCP；不接受 CODE_PACKAGE
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en: The scope of the origin server configuration does not exceed that of the creation API. The control fields for this validation only restrict the validation scope and do not extend the origin server onboarding configuration
parameters.help_zh: 源站配置范围不大于创建接口；本次检测控制字段只限定验证范围，不扩展源站接入配置
parameters.name: body

code.description_en: The API status code. SUCCESS indicates that the API completed normally. For the origin server result, see data.status
code.description_zh: 接口正常完成为 SUCCESS，源站结果见 data.status

data.description_en: The read-only, one-time, and bounded probe result. It is not persisted and is not associated with any subsequently created MCP
data.description_zh: 只读、一次性、有界的探测结果，不持久化，也不关联随后创建的 MCP

coverage.description_en: The check coverage. It describes the target, protocol, or HTTP request conditions for this request and does not prove that the formal gateway and other APIs are available
coverage.description_zh: 说明本次目标、协议或 HTTP 请求条件，不证明正式网关及其他接口可用

backendMcpProtocol.description_en: The evidence-verified legacy or modern protocol. This field is empty during HTTP interface checks
backendMcpProtocol.description_zh: 有证据验证的 legacy 或 modern；HTTP 接口检查时为空

headerNames.description_en: The list of non-sensitive header names. Internal platform routing and network identities are excluded
headerNames.description_zh: 仅返回非敏感名称，不包含平台内部路由或网络身份

items.description_en: The header name only. Header values are not returned
items.description_zh: 仅 Header 名称，不返回 Header 值

method.description_en: The HTTP method selected for this check. This field is empty for direct connections
method.description_zh: 本次选定 HTTP 方法；直连时为空

path.description_en: The redacted summary of the HTTP path selected for this check. This field is empty for direct connections
path.description_zh: 本次选定 HTTP 路径的脱敏摘要；直连时为空

protocol.description_en: The evidence-verified MCP transport. This field is empty during HTTP interface checks
protocol.description_zh: 有证据验证的 MCP Transport；HTTP 接口检查时为空

target.description_en: The summary of the origin server target for this request. It does not contain sensitive query parameters or credentials
target.description_zh: 本次源站目标摘要，不包含敏感 query 或凭据

viaGateway.description_en: This field is fixed to false for origin server checks before creation and does not indicate that the resource is ready
viaGateway.description_zh: 创建前源站检测固定为 false，不表示资源已 READY

error.description_en: The origin server diagnostics. This field indicates origin server failures and is empty upon success. Origin 401 errors or connection failures are not uniformly mapped to API exceptions
error.description_zh: 源站失败由本字段表达；成功时为空，不把源站 401 或连接失败统一映射为接口异常

code.description_en: The bounded diagnostic code. The original error body from the origin server is not returned
code.description_zh: 仅返回有界诊断码，不返回源站原始错误正文

message.description_en: The trimmed and redacted diagnostic information. This field does not contain credentials or original responses
message.description_zh: 经过裁剪和脱敏的必要诊断，不包含凭据或原始响应

retryable.description_en: Specifies whether the operation is suitable for retry under a restricted policy. This field does not trigger automatic retries
retryable.description_zh: 表示是否适合按受限策略重试，不触发自动重试

source.description_en: The source of the error. Valid values: MAGIC, ROUTER, NETWORK, ORIGIN, or UNKNOWN. This value is determined solely based on actual evidence
source.description_zh: MAGIC、ROUTER、NETWORK、ORIGIN 或 UNKNOWN；仅按实际证据判断

stage.description_en: The detection or publishing stage where the error occurred
stage.description_zh: 发生错误的检测或发布阶段

httpResult.description_en: The HTTP check result. It is only returned for the HTTP type. The definition is separated from the actual request status. It is null for direct connections. A 2xx status code only proves the success of this request and does not prove that business functions or other APIs are available
httpResult.description_zh: 仅 HTTP 类型返回，定义与实际请求状态分开；直连为 null。2xx 只证明本次请求，不证明业务功能或其他接口可用

connectionStatus.description_en: The target connection status. Valid values: PASSED, FAILED, NOT_RUN, or UNKNOWN. It is judged only based on the actual target connection evidence for this request
connectionStatus.description_zh: PASSED、FAILED、NOT_RUN 或 UNKNOWN；仅按本次实际目标连接证据判断

definitionStatus.description_en: The API definition check result. Valid values: PASSED, FAILED, or NOT_RUN. The value is NOT_RUN when no OpenAPI specification is available
definitionStatus.description_zh: PASSED、FAILED 或 NOT_RUN；无 OpenAPI 时为 NOT_RUN

httpStatusCode.description_en: The actual HTTP status code received. It is empty if the request was not executed or no response was received
httpStatusCode.description_zh: 实际收到的 HTTP 状态码；未执行或未收到响应时为空

observations.description_en: The declared and actual test results for a single origin server controlled endpoint. This is an empty array for the HTTP type
observations.description_zh: 单源站受控端点的声明与实测结果；HTTP 类型为空数组

backendMcpProtocol.description_en: The backend MCP protocol policy. Valid values: legacy or modern
backendMcpProtocol.title_en: 后端 MCP 协议策略
backendMcpProtocol.title_zh: 后端 MCP 协议策略

declared.description_en: Indicates whether the origin server declares support for this combination. This field is empty when there is no declaration evidence
declared.description_zh: 源站是否声明支持本组合；无声明证据时为空

declaredVersions.description_en: The list of declared versions. It only retains the date versions actually declared by the origin server and does not infer the full set from a single negotiation
declaredVersions.description_zh: 仅保留源站实际声明的日期版本，不由一次协商推断全集

items.description_en: The date version that the origin server declares support for
items.description_zh: 源站声明支持的日期版本

endpoint.description_en: The desensitized origin server or controlled subsequent endpoint. Sensitive query parameters are not returned
endpoint.description_zh: 脱敏后的源站或受控后续端点，不返回敏感 query

negotiatedVersion.description_en: The actual version used. For legacy, it is the negotiated version. For modern, it is the selected and verified date version. This field is empty when unconfirmed
negotiatedVersion.description_zh: Legacy 为协商版本，Modern 为选择并验证的日期版本；未确认时为空

protocol.description_en: The protocol. Valid values: SSE or StreamableHTTP. The modern policy is only combined with StreamableHTTP
protocol.description_zh: SSE 或 StreamableHTTP；modern 仅与 StreamableHTTP 组合

sessionMode.description_en: The session mode. Valid values: STATEFUL, STATELESS, NOT_APPLICABLE, or UNKNOWN. A direct legacy connection without a session is not automatically judged as failed
sessionMode.description_zh: STATEFUL、STATELESS、NOT_APPLICABLE 或 UNKNOWN；直连 Legacy 无 Session 不自动判失败

verificationStatus.description_en: The protocol verification status. Valid values: VERIFIED, UNSUPPORTED, FAILED, or UNKNOWN. UNSUPPORTED requires protocol evidence
verificationStatus.description_zh: VERIFIED、UNSUPPORTED、FAILED 或 UNKNOWN；UNSUPPORTED 必须有协议证据

probeId.description_en: The ID used only to correlate desensitized logs. It is not used for queries, authorization, binding MCPs, or reusing check evidence
probeId.description_zh: 仅用于关联脱敏日志，不用于查询、授权、绑定 MCP 或复用检测证据

probedAt.description_en: The observation time in ISO 8601 UTC format

recommendation.description_en: The recommended protocol combination. It only comes from verified combinations that the platform can access. This field is empty when no combinations are available or for the HTTP type
recommendation.description_zh: 只来自已验证且平台可接入的组合；无可用组合或 HTTP 类型时为空

backendMcpProtocol.description_en: The backend MCP protocol policy. Valid values: legacy or modern
backendMcpProtocol.title_en: 后端 MCP 协议策略
backendMcpProtocol.title_zh: 后端 MCP 协议策略

originProtocolVersion.description_en: The origin server MCP date version actually negotiated or selected and verified in this request, in YYYY-MM-DD format. It is null when unconfirmed. It only displays the origin server protocol date metadata. It can be filled in during creation and modified during updates. If omitted during an update, the current value is retained. It does not control backend requests or the external protocol of the gateway
originProtocolVersion.description_zh: 本次实际协商或选择并验证的源站 MCP 日期版本，格式为 YYYY-MM-DD；未确认时为 null。仅展示源站协议日期元信息，可在创建时填写、更新时修改，更新省略时保留当前值，不控制后端请求或网关对外协议
originProtocolVersion.title_en: 源站 MCP 协议日期版本
originProtocolVersion.title_zh: 源站 MCP 协议日期版本

protocol.description_en: The protocol. Valid values: SSE or StreamableHTTP. The modern policy is only combined with StreamableHTTP
protocol.description_zh: SSE 或 StreamableHTTP；modern 仅与 StreamableHTTP 组合

selectedConfiguration.description_en: The combination actually used for tool queries. Filling in this field does not mean verification passed. It is empty for the HTTP type
selectedConfiguration.description_zh: 实际工具查询使用的组合；填写不等于验证通过，HTTP 类型时为空

backendMcpProtocol.description_en: The backend MCP protocol policy. Valid values: legacy or modern
backendMcpProtocol.title_en: 后端 MCP 协议策略
backendMcpProtocol.title_zh: 后端 MCP 协议策略

originProtocolVersion.description_en: The origin server MCP date version actually negotiated or selected and verified in this request, in YYYY-MM-DD format. It is null when unconfirmed. It only displays the origin server protocol date metadata. It can be filled in during creation and modified during updates. If omitted during an update, the current value is retained. It does not control backend requests or the external protocol of the gateway
originProtocolVersion.description_zh: 本次实际协商或选择并验证的源站 MCP 日期版本，格式为 YYYY-MM-DD；未确认时为 null。仅展示源站协议日期元信息，可在创建时填写、更新时修改，更新省略时保留当前值，不控制后端请求或网关对外协议
originProtocolVersion.title_en: 源站 MCP 协议日期版本
originProtocolVersion.title_zh: 源站 MCP 协议日期版本

protocol.description_en: The protocol. Valid values: SSE or StreamableHTTP. The modern policy is only combined with StreamableHTTP
protocol.description_zh: SSE 或 StreamableHTTP；modern 仅与 StreamableHTTP 组合

stage.description_en: The current check stage. Valid values: AUTHORIZE, VALIDATE, RATE_LIMIT, NETWORK, NETWORK_CONTEXT, CONNECT, DISCOVER, INITIALIZE, SESSION_CHECK, TOOLS_LIST, HTTP_DEFINITION, HTTP_REQUEST, CLEANUP, EXECUTION, or COMPLETE

status.description_en: The check result of the origin server. Valid values: SUCCESS, PARTIAL, or FAILED. SUCCESS indicates that the protocol check passed but no capabilities were declared or the tools capability is missing. A completely empty tool list also passes. PARTIAL indicates that the tool query failed or was truncated. For HTTP, PARTIAL indicates that only the definition was checked or required evidence is unknown
status.description_zh: SUCCESS、PARTIAL 或 FAILED。协议检查通过但未声明任何能力或无 tools 能力为 SUCCESS；完整空工具列表也通过，工具查询失败或截断为 PARTIAL。HTTP 仅定义检查或必需证据未知为 PARTIAL

tools.description_en: The list of restricted metadata for this request. Tools are not executed. An empty array is returned if tools are not declared, the list is completely empty, or it is the HTTP type. Evaluate this together with toolsStatus and toolsComplete
tools.description_zh: 本次受限元数据列表，不执行工具。未声明 tools、完整空列表或 HTTP 类型返回 []，结合 toolsStatus 和 toolsComplete 判断

inputSchema.description_en: The input schema defined by the protocol, represented as a JSON string
inputSchema.description_zh: 协议定义的输入 Schema，采用 JSON 字符串表示

outputSchema.description_en: The output schema defined by the protocol, represented as a JSON string
outputSchema.description_zh: 协议定义的输出 Schema，采用 JSON 字符串表示

toolDescription.description_en: The untrusted description text returned by the origin server. It is escaped when displayed and is not executed as an instruction
toolDescription.description_zh: 源站返回的不可信描述文本，展示时转义，不作为指令执行

toolName.description_en: The declared name of the tool. Only metadata is displayed
toolName.description_zh: 工具声明的名称，仅展示元数据

toolsComplete.description_en: Indicates whether the tool list is complete. The value is true for COMPLETE or EMPTY, and false for TRUNCATED. The value is null if not queried, not declared, or failed. Completeness cannot be determined solely by an empty array
toolsComplete.description_zh: COMPLETE/EMPTY 为 true，TRUNCATED 为 false；未查询、未声明或失败为 null，不能只以空数组判断完整性

toolsStatus.description_en: The tool query status. Valid values: NOT_RUN, NOT_DECLARED, EMPTY, COMPLETE, TRUNCATED, or FAILED. If tools are not declared, the value is NOT_DECLARED and tools/list is not executed. For the HTTP type, the value is NOT_RUN
toolsStatus.description_zh: NOT_RUN、NOT_DECLARED、EMPTY、COMPLETE、TRUNCATED 或 FAILED。未声明 tools 时为 NOT_DECLARED 且不执行 tools/list；HTTP 类型为 NOT_RUN

warnings.description_en: The coverage and completeness limitations of this check
warnings.description_zh: 本次检测的覆盖和完整性限制

code.description_en: The structured identifier for the detection limitation
code.description_zh: 检测限制的结构化标识

message.description_en: The description of limitations such as UNKNOWN, not executed, or truncated. This field does not contain credentials or original responses
message.description_zh: 说明 UNKNOWN、未执行或截断等限制，不包含凭据及原始响应
message.example: The tool preview limit was reached; protocol verification succeeded.

httpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code of the POP API request
httpStatusCode.description_zh: POP 接口请求的 HTTP 状态码

message.description_en: The API processing result, which does not include the original response from the origin server
message.description_zh: 接口处理结果，不包含源站原始响应

requestId.description_en: The ID used to correlate this API call
requestId.description_zh: 用于关联本次 API 调用

success.description_en: Indicates whether the API was processed successfully. This indicates that authorization, parameter checks, and execution mechanisms completed normally, but does not mean the origin server check succeeded
success.description_zh: 表示授权、参数检查和执行机制正常完成，不等同于源站检测成功
